name: clean-corporate
description: A well-built corporate site for an ASX-listed industrial group (Meridian Industrial Group, Sydney), category corporate_enterprise. Exercises the corporate key facts (what the company does, headquarters, leadership or size from JSON-LD numberOfEmployees and the leadership list, press contact), the corporate applicability rules (breadcrumbs and search required, related links on the product page, press page expected at medium), an Australian address and phone, and a newsroom with dated releases. Must trigger zero fail findings.

expected.notes: Category corporate_enterprise at high confidence: Corporation JSON-LD, nav labels Newsroom / Investors / Sustainability / Careers, URL patterns /investors and /careers. Roles: product=/what-we-do (nav 'What we do'), blog=/newsroom ('Newsroom'), about, contact; pricing missing. Key facts: what_company_does from the meta description, headquarters from the PostalAddress, leadership_or_size from numberOfEmployees (a QuantitativeValue, which the extractor must read as a count) with the Leadership list and '12,400 people' as text fallbacks, contact_or_press_method from media@. The product page carries a Related section so related_links passes on a corporate site where it is graded at low; the newsroom is a listing and is skipped. The Australian phone (+61 2 9000 0000, a single-digit area code) is read by the international grouping grammar; the address by the street grammar ('100 George Street').
